push.title: W 4-2 vs SkeeBD Scouts | You: 9.7 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, a 9.7. I'm officially out of superlatives, and I keep a lot of 'em in my pocket.

THE GOOD
+ 96% passing on 26 attempts, up from your usual 78%. Your passes had more accuracy than a weather app.
+ 3 shots at SkeeBD Scouts's goal. You were hungry in front of goal, and I love a hungry striker.
+ 1 key pass. You made your teammates look like heroes. That's real leadership.
+ Man of the Match, your 14th for us. MOTM. Put it on the fridge and the resume.
+ PhogsToffees owes you a milkshake for those passes.

THE BAD
- 1 tackle won: -0.1. Slow down a hair.
- Shots on target: 67%. Decent, but top-quarter forwards get to 90%+. That's the next rung.

buddskees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: You can't rush a good brisket or a good player.

Gold star, big hug, see you next match. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.3. That ranks as your 3rd best match performance of the season. Proud of you, partner.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at SkeeBD Scouts's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ 2 key passes. That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ You and buddskees had more chemistry than a high school lab.
+ Your 3rd best match performance of the season, at 8.3. Every season needs a few of these.
+ Team-high 27 passes attempted. Bottle that and bring it next match.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 4 on target. Golden rule: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide.
- 70% passing (19 of 27, down from your usual 86%). Tell you what: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder. Believe.
- 1 tackle won: -0.1. Let's not make it a habit.

Skills corner: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. A coach's whistle is just a fancy way of saying 'I care.'

Biscuits are on me, again. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
A 7.6, BellyTb1. You did the little things, and the little things added up.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at SkeeBD Scouts's goal. Keep finding those looks; the goals will follow.
+ Better match rating than any of their humans (7.6 vs their best 7.4). Keep stacking those bricks.
+ Better pass accuracy than any of their humans (86% vs their best 85%). More of that, please and thank you.
+ Team-high 3 tackles attempted. That's the stuff I want framed.
+ 2 goals conceded chipped in +0.1. Every bit helps.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Quick fix: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot. Rome, day by day.
- Tackle success 0%, down from your usual 41%. That's on the to-do list now.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.6 (best was buddskees's 9.7). It's a small thing until it's the whole thing.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was buddskees's 1). Honest truth: that cost us.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 21 (best was PhogsToffees's 27). Back to basics: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.

Back-garden drill: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

BellyTb1, one more thing before you log off: Believe it, then go do it.

You're closer than you think. Trust the process, and trust your teammates. - Coach Lasso
